appraiser_land.rule: where no vacant-lot sales are nearby, land = the appraiser's land value / this ratio

rents.range_basis: 10th-90th percentile over 38 tracts of ACS 2020-2024 rent of units built 2020 or later over all rented units
rents.evidence: python -m jobs.check_rents_acs: ACS 2020-2024 B25111 (median gross rent of units built 2020 or later) over B25064 (all rented units), median over 38 tracts with lots in Miami. Units built 2010-2019: 1.067 over 145 tracts.
rents.caveat: Census rents include long-tenure leases and utilities; no public rent rolls outside Chicago. Replace with a rent source when one is available.

property_tax.basis: 19.9544 mills on taxable value x 0.85 (Florida just value is set near 85% of sale price after the 15% cost-of-sale deduction, s. 193.011(8))
property_tax.rate_note: Miami-Dade 2026 adopted millage, City of Miami (code 0100): city 7.3616, schools 6.6230, county 4.9677, library 0.2812, Children's Trust 0.4638, South Florida WMD and Everglades 0.2301, FIND 0.0270. Downtown Development Authority area adds 0.3800.
property_tax.caveat: Non-homestead rate for an in-city lot; special districts some lots pay are not included.
